### 2026-10-27: Today, I planned and started the project. I first got an idea of what it will look like, then I made started choosing components as I went. I have a supercapacitor as a battery, and some really ultra

**4h**

Today, I planned and started the project. I first got an idea of what it will look like, then I made started choosing components as I went. I have a supercapacitor as a battery, and some really ultra low power components. I want my project to run on RF harvesting and solar.

**2h**

Today I found my next components. I chose the microntroller and clock. Microcontroller will be an MSP430FR2111IPW16, and my RTC clock is going to be a PCF2131TFY. Also started working on the wiring a little bit here and there.
